events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in music history, opened on August 15, 1969, featuring 32 acts over four days in Bethel, New York.

angles.name: Woodstock Vibes
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since the summer of love climaxed at Woodstock. Which iconic performance would you have loved to witness live?

events.title: Elvis Presley's Passing
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, the 'King of Rock and Roll', passed away on August 16, 1977, at the age of 42.

angles.name: Remembering The King
angles.copy: Today marks 49 years since we lost the one and only Elvis Presley. He would have been 91. His music continues to define generations. What's your favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Tupac Shakur's Passing
events.blurb: Tupac Shakur, born June 16, 1971, was shot dead in Las Vegas on September 7, 1996, and died on September 13, 1996, at the age of 25.

angles.name: Tupac Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the profound impact of Tupac Shakur, who would have been 55 this year. His lyrical genius and influence on hip-hop remain unmatched.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's Passing
events.blurb: Jimi Hendrix, born November 27, 1942, a revolutionary guitarist, passed away on September 18, 1970, at the age of 27.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Legacy
angles.copy: Today we remember the incomparable Jimi Hendrix, who would have been 84. His innovative guitar work forever changed the landscape of rock music. What's your favourite Hendrix riff?

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic album 'Abbey Road' was released in the UK on September 26, 1969, and in the US on October 1, 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Icon
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover is still one of the most famous in history. Which track is on repeat for you?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead vocalist of The Pretenders, was born on September 7, 1951, in Akron, Ohio.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Her distinctive voice and fierce spirit with The Pretenders continue to inspire.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the iconic frontman of Oasis and a successful solo artist, was born on September 21, 1972, in Manchester.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! The voice of a generation and still rocking. What's your favourite Oasis or solo anthem?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic single 'Imagine' was released in the US on October 11, 1971, and in the UK in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine Peace
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon released the timeless anthem 'Imagine'. Its message of peace and unity resonates just as strongly today.

events.title: First iPod Released Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the first-generation iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising portable music players.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? Twenty-five years ago, the first iPod dropped and changed how we listened to music forever. What was the first song you loaded onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the release of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', on October 5, 1962.

angles.name: Bond, James Bond
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Sixty-four years of 007 thrills. Who's your favourite Bond and which theme tune gets you shaken, not stirred?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon, co-founder of The Beatles and an iconic solo artist, was born on October 9, 1940, in Liverpool.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we celebrate the enduring legacy of John Lennon. A true visionary whose music still inspires millions.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: John Cleese, the legendary British actor, comedian, and writer, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, was born on October 27, 1939.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From 'Monty Python' to 'Fawlty Towers', his comedic genius is unparalleled.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Legacy
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles unveiled their groundbreaking 'White Album'. Its diverse tracks proved their genius. What's your hidden gem from the double LP?

events.title: Freddie Mercury's Passing
events.blurb: Freddie Mercury, the iconic lead singer of Queen, born September 5, 1946, passed away on November 24, 1991, at the age of 45.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost the one and only Freddie Mercury. He would have been 80 this year. His voice and stage presence remain legendary. What's your favourite Queen song?
